name: word-counter-schema
description: Simple starter JSON Schemas for the Word Counter project.

files.description: Text input source such as file, stdin, or inline text.
Tokenizer, output format, normalization, and filter options.
Ranked top-word or bottom-word frequency row.
Normalized request object for CLI/API command execution.
Metric comparison result for two sources.
Mapping of source names to stats for compare or multi-file stats.
History record object for previous command invocations.
